purpose: Validation-only screen of a zero-initialized reversible per-channel affine adapter after MeanStd normalization in MambaTSv3AutoCon.
research_question: Can the two-parameter-per-channel reversible affine adapter improve exact MambaTSv3AutoCon on representative ETT domains without changing the shared Mamba/AutoCon backbone?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory screen. Every job sets skip_test=true; no test metrics, predictions, or held-out selection are permitted.
claim_boundary: A pass is local evidence for this adapter on the registered ETT cells only; it does not establish an independent AutoCon causal effect, universal accuracy, or efficiency advantage.

required_before_launch: verify the three ETT fingerprints and exact 18-job expansion
freeze MeanStd normalization, AutoCon lambda and optimizer budget
keep test execution disabled for every job
preserve one source snapshot and output root

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Only mamba_ts_revin_affine differs between the two registered arms; no capacity, lambda, normalization or optimizer search is permitted.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: Both arms share split, features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epoch budget, patience and MeanStd normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_difference: The affine arm adds one log-scale and one shift parameter per input channel, initialized to the identity, after the existing window normalization; the Mamba scan and AutoCon representation are unchanged.
capacity_fairness_contract.efficiency_boundary: Any speed or memory claim requires a separate fixed-shape resource measurement.

phases.name: affine_candidate_h96
phases.purpose: MambaTSv3AutoCon with the zero-initialized reversible affine adapter.

phases.name: exact_v3_control_h96
phases.purpose: Exact current MambaTSv3AutoCon control with the affine adapter disabled.

comparison_contract.primary_contrast: affine candidate minus exact v3 control
comparison_contract.pass_rule: The candidate must improve exact control in at least 2 of 3 seeds on at least two datasets; otherwise stop this route without any held-out release.

stopping_rules: If fewer than two datasets satisfy the paired improvement gate, stop the affine route with no held-out release or further tuning.
Do not call the adapter an independent AutoCon causal effect because it changes the forecast normalization path jointly with the representation objective.
Report all three registered datasets and all seeds, including failures.
